In this episode, I break down how AI is about to disrupt healthcare, retail, and professional services, and more importantly, what you can do about it. Instead of focusing on which jobs are going away, I share specific business ideas you can start today, from IV therapy and mobile Botox to product sourcing, reselling, dashboards, fractional CFO agencies, and AI implementation services. If AI is changing the game anyway, this is how you get on the winning side of it.

Enjoy!
